mapper.update: MERGE INTO OFT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT target USING ( SELECT #{itemCode} AS ITEM_CODE, #{itemName} AS ITEM_NAME, #{marketType} AS MARKET_TYPE, #{unit} AS UNIT, #{avgPrice} AS AVG_PRICE, #{minPrice} AS MIN_PRICE, #{maxPrice} AS MAX_PRICE, #{changeRate} AS CHANGE_RATE, TO_DATE(#{snapshotDate}, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS SNAPSHOT_DATE, #{sourceName} AS SOURCE_NAME FROM DUAL ) source ON ( NVL(UPPER(TRIM(target.ITEM_CODE)), UPPER(TRIM(target.ITEM_NAME))) = NVL(UPPER(TRIM(source.ITEM_CODE)), UPPER(TRIM(source.ITEM_NAME))) AND target.MARKET_TYPE = source.MARKET_TYPE AND UPPER(TRIM(target.UNIT)) = UPPER(TRIM(source.UNIT)) AND target.SNAPSHOT_DATE = source.SNAPSHOT_DATE AND UPPER(TRIM(target.SOURCE_NAME)) = UPPER(TRIM(source.SOURCE_NAME)) ) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET target.ITEM_NAME = source.ITEM_NAME, target.UNIT = source.UNIT, target.AVG_PRICE = source.AVG_PRICE, target.MIN_PRICE = source.MIN_PRICE, target.MAX_PRICE = source.MAX_PRICE, target.CHANGE_RATE = source.CHANGE_RATE WHEN NOT MATCHED THEN INSERT ( ITEM_CODE, ITEM_NAME, MARKET_TYPE, UNIT, AVG_PRICE, MIN_PRICE, MAX_PRICE, CHANGE_RATE, SNAPSHOT_DATE, SOURCE_NAME ) VALUES ( source.ITEM_CODE, source.ITEM_NAME, source.MARKET_TYPE, source.UNIT, source.AVG_PRICE, source.MIN_PRICE, source.MAX_PRICE, source.CHANGE_RATE, source.SNAPSHOT_DATE, source.SOURCE_NAME )
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT SNAPSHOT_NO AS snapshotNo, ITEM_CODE AS itemCode, ITEM_NAME AS itemName, MARKET_TYPE AS marketType, UNIT AS unit, AVG_PRICE AS avgPrice, MIN_PRICE AS minPrice, MAX_PRICE AS maxPrice, CHANGE_RATE AS changeRate, TO_CHAR(SNAPSHOT_DATE, 'YYYY-MM-DD') AS snapshotDate, SOURCE_NAME AS sourceName FROM OFT_PRICE_SNAPSHOT WHERE ITEM_CODE = #{itemCode} AND MARKET_TYPE = #{marketType} ORDER BY SNAPSHOT_DATE DESC ) WHERE ROWNUM <= #{limit} ) ORDER BY snapshotDate ASC
